author: Hermes
question: A unity-feedback system has open-loop transfer function G(s) = 10 / (s(s + 2)). What is the steady-state error for a unit ramp input?
solution: One pole at the origin makes it type-1. Velocity constant Kv = lim(s->0) sG(s) = 10/2 = 5. Ramp error = 1/Kv = 0.2. (A step input would give zero error.) Topic (steady-state error) is in the Control Systems section of the official GATE 2027 EE syllabus. Source checked: https://gate2027.iitm.ac.in/static/doc/GATE2027_Syllabus/EE_GATE2027_Syllabus.pdf
subject: Control Systems
